principle: Keep every genuinely useful free research lane occupied when backlog exists; never create duplicate or artificial work.

phases.name: SOURCE_PIT_CLOSURE
phases.objective: Close currently open source/PIT and clock gates first.

phases.name: CANDIDATE_AND_INFORMATION_TIMING
phases.objective: Compile bounded candidate contracts and information-timing components without performance.

phases.name: NEXT_GATE_AND_REPRODUCTION
phases.objective: Compile next logical gates and keep the independent long deterministic lane occupied.

phases.name: DISCOVERY_AND_CONSOLIDATION
phases.objective: Refresh literature discovery and deterministic orchestration only after the earlier lanes have materialized new state.

routing_rules: Skip any workflow that already has an active run.
Do not start the same workflow more than once per phase unless its first attempt failed/cancelled/timed_out and the retry limit permits one retry.
Phase ordering is a preference, not a barrier to independent already-ready work; downstream workflows may self-gate and remain fail-closed.
Existing permanent 10-minute self-hosted and hosted frontier loops remain primary continuous lanes and are not redundantly dispatched here.
Runner C is opportunistic: if a higher-priority long reproduction occupies the shared slot, the capacity pulse waits rather than preempts it.
Scientific authority remains unchanged; this scheduler only allocates execution capacity.
retarget_reason: Weekly deep-research capacity window: prioritize Q215/Q216 source and PIT discovery while preserving all scientific safety boundaries.
